snippet.title: Official Trailer | Heaven Does Not Respond
snippet.description:
Heaven Does Not Respond is a psychological and analog horror investigation game set in an alternate 2005 timeline. Play as intelligence agent, exploring a retro computer interface to decrypt hidden files, watch mysterious videos, and uncover dark secrets behind a young man’s sudden death.
